chapters.title: Erik Stormson (he/him) — Captain of the Broken Raven. Once a raider, now a leader trying to protect without becoming what he hates.
Bjorn Ice-Eyes (he/him) — The quiet blade—cold, dark, and fiercely loyal. His burned arm forces him to fight smarter, not louder.
Naya of the Coree (she/her) — Scout, hunter, and the quickest mind in the pines. Fierce, practical, and unwilling to be named by enemies.
Astrid Shield-Daughter (she/her) — Axe, discipline, and grit. She holds the line when everyone else wants to run—and pays for it in private.
Baggi Broad-Shoulder (he/him) — Erik’s right hand and the crew’s anchor. Built like a door, stubborn as a mule, steady under fire.
Olaf Loudmouth (he/him) — Morale and mischief with a frying pan that should be illegal. He jokes through fear because silence feels like surrender.
David Redbeard (he/him) — A giant with an axe and a horn of ‘borrowed’ mead. He trades in names and paths—and never for coin.
Caleb Turner (he/him) — Settler of the Pines Settlement. He carries a faded blue ribbon keepsake and grief that turns into courage.
Chief Wren-Tail (he/him) — Leader of the Coree. Beads and patience. He watches before he speaks, and when he speaks, the forest listens.
Kano (he/him) — Coree war-leader and hunter. Sharp-eyed, fast, and not impressed by Vikings until they bleed for children.
Chayton (he/him) — Interpreter and bridge between tongues. He keeps peace with words—until words aren’t enough.
Leif (he/him) — Viking oarsman with a steady heart. He learns what it means to defend instead of raid—and chooses it.
Rook (he/him, ‘good boy’) — Gray-black, thick-coated Viking dog with a warrior’s instincts. He growls at wind and treats the crew like his pack.
Dylan (he/him) — Settler from the Pines; father of Finn. Forced to spy for the Salt Wolves to save his son. Grief and fear make him a weapon pointed at his own people.
Finn (he/him) — Dylan’s young son; held hostage by the Salt Wolves. The blue ribbon on his wrist becomes a leash that controls his father.
Jorund (he/him) — Young Viking oarsman repeatedly saved by Leif. Represents the crew members learning to survive together.
Toma (he/him) — Young Coree scout captured and caged by the Black Ribbon. His rescue sparks the final cove confrontation.
The Black Ribbon — Harrow’s elite scouts and enforcers—quiet, organized, frighteningly professional.
